title: Tom Chooses a Career
text:
Tom is seventeen and goes to a technical school in Krakow. He studies biology and chemistry because he wants to become a nurse. He works in a small cafe on Saturdays to earn some money.

Last month he visited a hospital with his class. The nurses there were very friendly and explained their daily work. Tom now thinks that a career in healthcare is a good choice for him.

questions.text: Where does Tom go to school?
options: In a technical school in Krakow

questions.text: What did Tom's class do last month?
Why does Tom work in a cafe on Saturdays?
options: He wants to learn how to cook

questions.text: What is Tom most likely to do after finishing school?

the job or type of work you do for much of your life
kind and easy to talk to

paragraph_translations: Tom ma siedemnaście lat i chodzi do technikum w Krakowie. Uczy się biologii i chemii, ponieważ chce zostać pielęgniarzem. W soboty pracuje w małej kawiarni, żeby zarobić trochę pieniędzy.

W zeszłym miesiącu odwiedził szpital ze swoją klasą. Pielęgniarki tam były bardzo przyjazne i wyjaśniły, jak wygląda ich codzienna praca. Tom uważa teraz, że kariera w ochronie zdrowia to dobry wybór dla niego.
